`python3 roster.py inactive` now lists every learner whose last login was 14 or more days ago. Run against the current data, it gives:

```
L-004  Dara Novak           dara@example.org         2026-08-11  54 days
L-002  Ben Whitlock         ben.w@example.org        2026-09-02  32 days
```

Each row shows the last login date and the number of days idle, with the longest-idle learner first so the most at-risk are at the top. The other commands sort by name, so say if you'd prefer that here too.

The threshold is the `INACTIVE_AFTER_DAYS` constant at the top of `roster.py`, and "today" is the date of the machine running the command. I also added the command to the usage text and the README.
